description:
The Hindu almanac (panchang) for a day at New Delhi (IST): the five limbs (vāra, tithi, nakshatra, yoga,
    karana), sunrise and sunset, Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda and Gulika, Abhijit, and the day's chaughadia. With a
    birth_star, also that star's tārā for the day.

    date: "today" or YYYY-MM-DD (within a year either way). birth_star: optional nakshatra name.
name: panchang
title: Today's panchang
